_comment: The record. Every on-screen fact traces to a key here, and the text on a fact card must be one of that key's approved forms, verbatim. Day counts are derived from the three dates and the lint fails if the stated numbers disagree with the arithmetic. Edited by humans only.

trialCourt.statement: Pickens County; Judge Henry F. Floyd presiding.

appellateCounsel.statement: Appellate counsel: Dan Stacey. Appellate only; never in trial-era scenes. Deceased; never voiced by an impersonator.
appellateCounsel.note: Dan Stacey is a permitted name on screen because he is honoured through the record (episode 005); he is still never voiced.

reversal.statement: Reversed March 27, 2000, unanimously, by the South Carolina Supreme Court.

framing.statement: Complete innocence. The Court said it should have been impossible to convict him. Never a technicality, never a procedural win.
forms: The Court said it should have been impossible to convict him.
It should have been impossible to convict him.

erasure.statement: The original opinion was withdrawn and refiled June 12, 2000, with language deleted, while the State was still holding him past the March 27 order. Seventy-seven days after the opinion.
forms: Withdrawn and refiled June 12, 2000. Language deleted.
Seventy-seven days later, the opinion was refiled with language deleted.

overDetention.statement: Held ninety-three days past the March 27, 2000 order that freed him, until the remittitur of June 28, 2000.
forms: Ordered freed March 27, 2000. Held ninety-three more days.
overDetention.note: The handoff of October 6, 2026 carried seventy-seven here. This repository's record, locked by Michael on September 5, 2026 against the case file, derives ninety-three from the remittitur date. Seventy-seven is the erasure. See docs/COUNSEL_PACKET.md.

cadillac.statement: He was the number one Cadillac salesman at twenty-six.
forms: Number one on the board. Twenty-six years old.

driveThru.statement: The detective driving, the chief in the passenger seat, Michael in the back seat.
forms: The detective drove. The chief rode beside him. Michael sat in the back.

dansInstruction.statement: “Get those words into a record nobody can edit.” Given by Dan directly, over the telephone.
forms: “Get those words into a record nobody can edit.”
Get those words into a record nobody can edit.

releaseDay.statement: A stretch limousine, with Pops and Uncle JP.
forms: A stretch limousine. Pops and Uncle JP.

familyLand.statement: Neriah Fennell’s 860-acre Recovery estate, Decatur County, Georgia. Never a bare number, always framed. Out of scope for the six pilots.

derived._comment: Computed from dates by the lint; these are the values the record expects. A mismatch fails the build.

numberWords._comment: Number words that, when they appear in a script or card, must be consistent with the record.

seventy-seven.meaning: the erasure: opinion to refiled opinion

twenty-six.meaning: age at arrest; the Cadillac board

proximityRules.reason: He was twenty-six on the Cadillac floor, not nineteen.

motiveTerms._comment: Warnings, not failures. Each supplies a motive the record does not establish or states a legal conclusion no court reached. Carried over from the reel set's record. The deletion is stated; it is never motivated.

names._comment: Role labels only on screen until counsel clears real names. realNamesCleared is empty by default and edited by humans only. A name that appears in knownRealNames and is not in realNamesCleared or permitted fails the lint. Titles followed by a capitalised word (Judge X, Detective X) fail unless the name is cleared.

factualSignals._comment: Card text containing any of these without a canonKey is untagged factual text and fails validation.
